ranked_facts.why: the well-defined margin of the swelling is more characteristic of juvenile ossifying fibroma than fibrous dysplasia, which typically has an ill-defined margin

both fibrous dysplasia and juvenile ossifying fibroma can present with a ground-glass trabecular pattern, but this feature is not exclusive to these conditions and can be seen in other bone lesions as well
